question: How are Gaurī and the lord of Gaurī described when depicted together?
premises: Gaurī and Gaurīśvara are mentioned together.
Both are endowed with four arms.
inference: When depicted as a pair, Gaurī and Gaurīśvara are both four-armed.
plain_english: Gaurī and the lord of Gaurī are both endowed with four arms.
